prompt: Construct a single circular enclosure around the bench and chair, which are in front of the trashcan, so they can share shade. Keep the pot outside this enclosure to the right. Provide enough space inside for both the bench and the chair.
description: This scene highlights semantic relationships of 'in front of', 'behind', 'left', and 'right' based on the x-y convention (in front = lower x, behind = higher x, left = lower y, right = higher y). The bench is placed in front of the trashcan, and the chair is to the left of the bench, with the pot to the right of the bench. We then construct a single circular enclosure around the bench and chair, leaving the trashcan and pot outside of it.
